title: Very basic; construction feels cheap
text:
Very basic; construction feels cheap. I have several brands of kitchen scales that I use daily as I frequently test cookbooks from the UK that require metric conversions. This was my first Taylor scale, and I have to say that as an experienced baker, I was let down by the fact that you are limited to Imperial and grams (no liquid measurements with this scale, so forget about measuring in fl. oz. or ml). The max weight is 11 pounds. There are only two buttons and it is very simple to operate. The glass top is easy to wipe clean and has a hefty feel, but the plastic base is extremely lightweight and feels cheap.The plastic door to access the batteries feels cheaply made. I do like the look of the glass top, and this has a small footprint on the counter. Also, the fact that it takes two AAA batteries (vs. button-cell batteries like my thin-line digital scale) makes it easier to find / replace batteries (my thin digital scale requires unscrewing the battery compartment door to replace the batteries).

Verdict: This is fine for those looking for an entry-level scale, particularly for those weighing portions, or for weighing small letters, etc., but more experienced bakers and those who frequently cook using metric will want a scale that offers more versatility.

product_metadata.title: Taylor 3842 11lb Digital Glass Top Household Kitchen Scale, Universal, Silver
features: QUALITY AND PRECISION: Taylor has been making precision products for kitchen measurement for over 150 years, using only the highest quality components for accurate weighing. Measure precisely in both standard and metric units up to 11lb/5kg in 0.1oz/1g increments.
VERSATILE DESIGN: This product is made with a durable, tempered glass platform. The material is easy-to-clean and resists staining and flavor carry over.

SIMPLE & CONVENIENT: Weighing foods and small items should be hassle free, so this scale has intuitive features like Auto-Off (to conserve battery life), Tare (zero weights between additions) and even a Low Battery Indicator as a reminder for replacement.
EASY TO READ: The 0.5" LCD readout has crisp, clear digits.
BATTERIES INCLUDED: TWO (2) AAA batteries. Install or remove insulation tab to activate scale before first use.
description: The Glass Platform Food Scale is an essential part of any modern kitchen. This scale is designed to provide accurate portion control for a healthy lifestyle. How you cook is as important as what you cook. Weighing food is more accurate than taking volume measurements and can help guide a successful diet or delicious meal. The most accurate method of measurement is using a scale, and for over 165 years, Taylor has been making precision products for kitchen measurement, making us a trusted partner in the kitchen.
